# Immaculate Connections Travel Agency

> Travel agency in Cebu City, Philippines, for groups and families. Local and international tour packages, flight and ferry ticketing, hotel bookings, vans, coasters and buses with driver, and seminars, events and MICE, booked by one team. Quotations are free.

Departures: all current tour packages fly from Manila (NAIA) to Da Nang or Hanoi. Custom trips around Cebu, Bohol and Camotes are arranged on request.

Contact: +63 917 319 8540 (mobile), (032) 238 3343 (landline), immaculateconnectionsph@gmail.com, Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ImmaculateConnections.ph, Messenger: https://m.me/ImmaculateConnections.ph
Office: Unit 4E, 4th Floor, JL Millennium Building, Don Jose Avila Street, Cebu City, Cebu, Philippines 6000
